import math
import sys

MOD = 998244353

class FFT:
    MAX_K = 21
    MAX_N = 1 << MAX_K
    wR = [0.0] * MAX_N
    wI = [0.0] * MAX_N
    aR = [0.0] * MAX_N
    aI = [0.0] * MAX_N
    n = 0
    k = 0
    lastK = -1
    bitReverse = [0] * MAX_N

    @staticmethod
    def performTransform(inverse):
        if FFT.lastK != FFT.k:
            FFT.lastK = FFT.k
            FFT.bitReverse[0] = 0
            group = 0
            for i in range(1, FFT.n):
                if (i & (i - 1)) == 0:
                    group += 1
                FFT.bitReverse[i] = FFT.bitReverse[i ^ (1 << group)] ^ (1 << (FFT.k - 1 - group))
            
            FFT.wR[1] = 1.0
            FFT.wI[1] = 0.0
            for t in range(FFT.k - 1):
                angle = math.pi / FFT.n * (1 << (FFT.k - 1 - t))
                cosVal = math.cos(angle)
                sinVal = math.sin(angle)
                p2 = 1 << t
                p3 = p2 << 1
                for j in range(p2, p3):
                    idx = p3 + (j - p2) * 2
                    FFT.wR[idx] = FFT.wR[j]
                    FFT.wI[idx] = FFT.wI[j]
                    FFT.wR[idx + 1] = FFT.wR[j] * cosVal - FFT.wI[j] * sinVal
                    FFT.wI[idx + 1] = FFT.wR[j] * sinVal + FFT.wI[j] * cosVal
        
        for i in range(FFT.n):
            rev = FFT.bitReverse[i]
            if i < rev:
                temp = FFT.aR[i]
                FFT.aR[i] = FFT.aR[rev]
                FFT.aR[rev] = temp
                temp = FFT.aI[i]
                FFT.aI[i] = FFT.aI[rev]
                FFT.aI[rev] = temp
        
        if inverse:
            for i in range(FFT.n):
                FFT.aI[i] = -FFT.aI[i]
        
        len_val = 1
        while len_val < FFT.n:
            for i in range(0, FFT.n, len_val):
                wIndex = len_val
                for j in range(i + len_val, i + len_val * 2):
                    tr = FFT.aR[j] * FFT.wR[wIndex] - FFT.aI[j] * FFT.wI[wIndex]
                    ti = FFT.aR[j] * FFT.wI[wIndex] + FFT.aI[j] * FFT.wR[wIndex]
                    wIndex += 1
                    FFT.aR[j] = FFT.aR[i] - tr
                    FFT.aI[j] = FFT.aI[i] - ti
                    FFT.aR[i] += tr
                    FFT.aI[i] += ti
            len_val <<= 1

    @staticmethod
    def multiply(first, second):
        len1 = len(first)
        len2 = len(second)
        FFT.k = 0
        FFT.n = 1
        while FFT.n < len1 + len2 - 1:
            FFT.n <<= 1
            FFT.k += 1
        
        for i in range(FFT.n):
            FFT.aR[i] = first[i] if i < len1 else 0.0
            FFT.aI[i] = second[i] if i < len2 else 0.0
        
        FFT.performTransform(False)
        FFT.aR[FFT.n] = FFT.aR[0]
        FFT.aI[FFT.n] = FFT.aI[0]
        scaleFactor = -1.0 / FFT.n / 4.0
        
        for i in range(FFT.n - i + 1):
            r1 = FFT.aR[i] * FFT.aR[i] - FFT.aI[i] * FFT.aI[i]
            i1 = 2 * FFT.aR[i] * FFT.aI[i]
            r2 = FFT.aR[FFT.n - i] * FFT.aR[FFT.n - i] - FFT.aI[FFT.n - i] * FFT.aI[FFT.n - i]
            i2 = -2 * FFT.aR[FFT.n - i] * FFT.aI[FFT.n - i]
            nr = -i1 + i2
            ni = r1 - r2
            FFT.aR[i] = nr * scaleFactor
            FFT.aI[i] = ni * scaleFactor
            FFT.aR[FFT.n - i] = FFT.aR[i]
            FFT.aI[FFT.n - i] = -FFT.aI[i]
        
        FFT.performTransform(True)
        result = [0] * (len1 + len2 - 1)
        for i in range(len(result)):
            result[i] = round(FFT.aR[i]) % MOD
        return result

    @staticmethod
    def multiplyPrecise(first, second):
        sqrtMod = int(math.isqrt(MOD))
        low1 = [x % sqrtMod for x in first]
        high1 = [x // sqrtMod for x in first]
        low2 = [x % sqrtMod for x in second]
        high2 = [x // sqrtMod for x in second]
        
        r11 = FFT.multiply(low1, low2)
        r12 = FFT.multiply(low1, high2)
        r21 = FFT.multiply(high1, low2)
        r22 = FFT.multiply(high1, high2)
        
        result = [0] * len(r11)
        for i in range(len(result)):
            term1 = (sqrtMod * sqrtMod % MOD) * r22[i] % MOD
            term2 = sqrtMod * ((r12[i] + r21[i]) % MOD) % MOD
            result[i] = (term1 + term2 + r11[i]) % MOD
        return result

def recursivePower(base, exponent):
    if exponent == 1:
        return base
    if exponent & 1:
        return FFT.multiplyPrecise(base, recursivePower(base, exponent - 1))
    half = recursivePower(base, exponent >> 1)
    return FFT.multiplyPrecise(half, half)

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().split()
    if not data:
        return
    n = int(data[0])
    k = int(data[1])
    base = [0] * 10
    idx = 2
    for i in range(k):
        base[int(data[idx])] = 1
        idx += 1
    
    res = recursivePower(base, n // 2)
    total = 0
    for val in res:
        total = (total + val * val) % MOD
    print(total)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
